info.name: StayPoint daemon API
info.description:
End-to-end suite for the StayPoint daemon HTTP API (STA-346).

Run headless: scripts/api-e2e.sh. In Postman, import this file and staypoint.postman_environment.json, set `baseUrl` and `token`, and run folders in order: later folders reuse ids saved by earlier ones.

Generated by tests/api/build_collection.py; edit that, not this file.

Test names prefixed [STA-nnn] fail today because of that open daemon bug.

item.name: loopback origin is allowed and reflected

exec: pm.test("returns id and defaults", () => { pm.expect(j.id).to.match(/^task-/); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql("e2e task A");pm.expect(j.execution_stage).to.eql("todo"); pm.expect(j.is_blocked).to.eql(false); });

item.name: duplicate create (same name) makes a distinct task

exec: pm.test("B listed before A (created_at desc)", () => { const ids = j.tasks.map(t => t.id);const a = ids.indexOf(pm.collectionVariables.get("taskA"));const b = ids.indexOf(pm.collectionVariables.get("taskB"));pm.expect(a).to.be.above(-1); pm.expect(b).to.be.above(-1); pm.expect(b).to.be.below(a); });

item.name: list tasks: bad limit/offset fall back to defaults
[STA-357] list tasks: empty result is [] not null

exec: pm.test("tasks is an empty array", () => { pm.expect(j.tasks).to.be.an("array").that.is.empty; pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(0); });

item.name: list comments: oldest first, author defaulted
run-steps: empty list for new task
[STA-356] done without a work product -> 409/422, not 500
duplicate idempotency key returns the same interaction
confirmation targeting a document with no revisions -> 4xx

exec: pm.test("3 interactions ascending by id", () => { pm.expect(j.interactions).to.have.length(3);const ids = j.interactions.map(i => i.id);pm.expect(ids).to.eql([...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });

item.name: create a fourth interaction for the cross-task check
[STA-355] resolve via a different task's URL -> 404
[STA-355] cross-task resolve left the interaction pending
a new comment supersedes pending interactions
pending ones are now superseded; resolved one untouched
[STA-357] governance of a fresh task uses [] not null

exec: pm.test("empty arrays", () => { for (const k of ["reviewers","approvers","reviews","votes"]) pm.expect(j[k], k).to.be.an("array").that.is.empty; });

pm.test("one reviewer, one approver", () => { pm.expect(j.reviewers.filter(r => r.reviewer_id === "rev-1")).to.have.length(1);pm.expect(j.approvers.filter(a => a.approver_id === "app-1")).to.have.length(1);pm.expect(j.config.watchdog_agent_id).to.eql("wd-1"); });

item.name: [STA-355] stranger review + vote must not open the in_review -> done gate

exec: pm.test("stage done, comment kept", () => { pm.expect(j.task.execution_stage).to.eql("done");pm.expect(j.comments.map(c => c.message)).to.include("plan: do the thing"); });

pm.test("assignments, review, vote and every transition are logged", () => { const ev = j.audit_log;const types = ev.map(e => e.event_type);const hops = ev.filter(e => e.event_type === "state_transition").map(e => e.from_state + ">" + e.to_state);pm.expect(hops).to.include.members(["todo>in_progress","in_progress>in_review","in_review>done"]);pm.expect(types).to.include.members(["approval_vote"]);pm.expect(types.some(t => /review/.test(t))).to.eql(true);pm.expect(types.some(t => /reviewer/.test(t))).to.eql(true);pm.expect(types.some(t => /approver/.test(t))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: [STA-358] 9d audit also shows the comment and the interaction

exec: pm.test("comment + interaction events present", () => { const types = j.audit_log.map(e => e.event_type).join(" ");pm.expect(types).to.match(/comment/);pm.expect(types).to.match(/interaction/); });

item.name: re-register same id is an upsert
[STA-357] list threads: empty is [] not null

exec: pm.test("ordered by sequence_num", () => { const s = j.messages.map(m => m.sequence_num);pm.expect(s).to.eql([...s].sort((a, b) => a - b));pm.expect(j.messages[0].content).to.eql("hello"); });
pm.test("second message, has_more reflects total", () => { pm.expect(j.messages).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.messages[0].content).to.eql("hi");pm.expect(j.has_more).to.eql(j.total > 2); });

item.name: list threads includes it with message_count
seed again is a no-op (duplicate create)

exec: pm.test("updated, version bumped", () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("partial"); pm.expect(j.notes).to.eql("half done"); pm.expect(j.version).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: fleet overview lists the stub company
fleet comments include the new one

exec: pm.test("wrapped array", () => { pm.expect(j.comments.map(c => c.body)).to.include("from the e2e suite"); });
